<b>Creige</b> is a [[NPCs (Silksong)#Merchants|merchant]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. He is a [[Moorbugs|moorbug]] who sells a nectar drink at the [[Halfway Home]] in exchange for [[Rosaries]].

== Background ==
Creige is the owner and bartender of the Halfway Home, offering drinks and a place to rest for pilgrims.<ref>Creige: <i>"Lookin' for a drink, or a rest, or both? (...) Used to be just pilgrims trekkin' my way, but odd times these are, and you ain't even the strangest shell wandering about."</i></ref> Ever since the [[Haunting]] started affecting [[Pharloom]], only the stronger pilgrims are able to reach his home.<ref>Creige: <i>"S'only those few stronger pilgrims that survive to reach my home now... Pharloom's curse claims the rest. Poor sods, left to wander."</i></ref> He knows about the history of [[Sinner's Road]] and [[Bellhart]], and laments about their current state.<ref>Creige: <i>"Bellhart, over the moors, a great town I've heard it once was, heart of the path'n all, right smack in the middle of these midlands. Now it's all a'crumble... And that brittle vein of bells is crawling with nasties. Ain't no place left in Pharloom that can fairly claim to offer safety."</i></ref><ref>Creige: <i>"You visited them pens up above here, miss? Horrid place, once all about growing meat or some such. Meant to keep us moorbugs livin', and working, it's told... That damned place's long gone to the Haunting. Now the meat's running feral and free."</i></ref>

== In-game Events ==
As a bartender, Creige serves a unique nectar drink for {{R|10}}, which can be purchased to heal [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] for {{Damage|3}} and restore 6 [[Silk]].

After defeating [[Widow]] and releasing the residents of Bellhart, Creige's <i>[[Crawbug Clearing]]</i> wish appears on the [[wishwall]] in Bellhart. Alternatively, the wish can be taken by speaking directly with Creige. Speaking with Creige reveals that the Halfway Home is constantly troubled by the [[Craw]]s flying above, and that he wishes to build a scarecraw to scare them away. Creige then tasks Hornet with collecting 25 [[Ragpelt]] by killing the Crawbugs (dropped by Craws, [[Tallcraw]]s and [[Squatcraw]]s), and gives her a [[Crafting Kit]] as a reward for completing the wish. After returning to the Halfway Home some time later, a giant scarecrow is placed on top of the Halfway Home and the Craws that used to fly around are gone.

Creige offers the [[Vintage Nectar]] for {{R|480}} for the <i>[[Great Taste of Pharloom]]</i> wish. Upon payment, Hornet must retrieve it from Creige's basement, where she is ambushed by various [[Skarr]] enemies in the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Greymoor 4|enemy gauntlet]].

If Hornet is [[Cursed Crest|cursed]], Creige does not offer Hornet a drink, and instead insists she go to [[Yarnaby]] to get the cure. This also prevents Creige from offering the [[Vintage Nectar]].<ref>Creige: <i>"Well, don't be bringing such dangerous things in here! Head to the top of the moors. There's an old doctor up there hiding in her bell. Her remedies are said to often hurt more'n they help, but given your state, I'd say it's worth the risk."</i></ref>

{{HTalk|Would you simply have them slain? If so, your sturdy shell seems more than up to that task?}}<br>
If only it were so simple. Kill the ones above, and more just keep coming. It's the warmth of this home you see. Draws 'em right in.<br>

I'd been holding onto it for someone else, but they've been gone long enough now, I know they won't be returning.<br>
{{HTalk|Thank you sir. This is a worthy trade for my work. My tools shall attain an even sharper edge.}}

== Location ==
Creige can be found at the [[Halfway Home]] in the central area of [[Greymoor]]. His eastern door is initially locked, requiring Hornet to climb over the roof to reach the western door and unlock it from the inside.
